explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/11: if every odd integer is the sum of a squarefree number and a power of 2 then a positive proportion of primes are non-Wieferich. The statement proves the weaker consequence of infinitely many such primes under `all_odd`, as the docstring says, which is implied. 2^p ≢ 2 (mod p²) is the standard Wieferich negation for odd p; p = 2 satisfies it and is only one extra prime, so infinitude is unaffected. Faithful.
